title: Formula 1 & Motorsport Fandom Longest Quiet Streak
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f1telemetry:lap
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events by _time
| sort _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_day last(events) as prev_events
| eval gap_days=round((_time-prev_day)/86400,0)
| where isnotnull(prev_day) AND prev_events>0 AND events=0 AND gap_days>=2
| stats max(gap_days) as longest_quiet_streak_days
description: Finds the longest multi-day gap with zero formula 1 events after activity was previously present.
value: Quiet streaks often mean a broken export, a forgotten subscription, or a habit that silently died — all worth catching early.
implementation: Run daily on `f1telemetry:lap` after ingestion; investigate streaks that exceed your normal pause window for this domain.
visualization: Single-value tile for longest quiet streak with supporting timeline.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the longest stretch with no formula 1 activity at all so you can tell when a feed or habit went quiet for too long.
